text:
morgan-partners: Quick shout  CascadeHealth went live on GCP Marketplace today and included Redwood Dedicated as their recommended inference backend. They're committing to a 24-month reserved plan + option for Private VPC (PHI). Marketing asked for a short joint case study after 30 days. :tada:

felix-sales: Amazing news! Any special compliance asks from Cascade?

morgan-partners: They want customer-managed KMS, exportable audit logs to their Splunk instance, and SOC2 attestation bundled in the marketplace tile. Go-live onboarding kickoff next Tue 11am PT.

anya-marketing: Great  can we get a 1-sentence CTO quote + logo permission? Also need a 2-line technical blurb and a tiny SDK snippet for the marketplace tile by EOD Fri.

dev-eng: We can supply that. Draft perf blurb: "p95 token latency <60ms on reserved g5 pools for common EHR parsing flows; caching + batching reduce unit cost ~30% vs self-hosted." Tiny snippet (JS): ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const c=new Redwood({key:process.env.RWD_KEY});
const r=await c.generate({model:'rwd-qa-1',prompt:'Extract meds'});
console.log(r.text);
```

riley-sec: From security: need a signed BAA, KMS key policy review, and an HSM option for CMKs if Cascade requires it. I'll attach the checklist to the kickoff invite.

ops-bot: Onboarding ticket CH-3321 created and assigned to dev-eng, riley-sec. ETA 6 days.

felix-sales: Can engineering pre-provision a 2-node test pool in us-central1 for perf baselining next week?

dev-eng: Yes  I'll open an infra reservation. Also will prepare a 1-paragraph appendix describing the Dedicated connector for the case study.

anya-marketing: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and coordinate PR. Please drop any short one-liners about "why Cascade picked Redwood" here for the case study copy.

morgan-partners: One-liner: "Chose Redwood for predictable reserved pricing, private deployment options, and enterprise-grade audit controls."

riley-sec: Uploaded BAA template and KMS integration guide to CH-3321.

morgan-partners: Thanks team  kickoff invite sent. Agenda: intros, compliance checklist, infra plan, timeline, and case study deliverables. :raised_hands:
